operations.title: Four nodal roots contract E7 primitively to A1 cubed
operations.body: The four exceptional roots of a two-conic marked section form an orthogonal A1^4 subsystem in E7. Its embedding is primitive (gcd maximal minors one), the quotient is torsion-free, and the orthogonal intersection-cohomology lattice is A1^3 of discriminant eight. The direct-sum gluing index in E7 is eight.

operations.title: Integral A1^4-to-E7 embedding audit
operations.body: The checker verifies explicit root Gram matrices, maximal-minor gcd one, zero quotient torsion, an integral complement basis, its discriminant eight, and a unimodular orthogonal-root basis with Gram -2I3.

operations.title: Benincasa derives the nodal marked-section Gysin lattice
operations.body: Entry 1184: the four nodal roots in a boundary-sum section embed primitively as A1^4⊂E7; quotient torsion is zero. Their orthogonal IH/Gysin kernel is A1^3 (rank3, discr8), while A1^4⊕A1^3 has intrinsic index8 in E7. Thus smooth marks contribute E7 rank7, four-node marks contribute A1^3 rank3. Next is the explicit excision square matching these four roots to Entry 1181's signed local contraction.

authority_basis.summary: Record the primitive A1^4 contraction inside the E7 Gysin lattice.
